# Zilog Z80N

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from `crates/isa/src/z80.rs`. Edits here are overwritten; change the spec instead. -->

22 mnemonics, 30 encoded forms, operands little-endian. Generated from [`crates/isa/src/z80.rs`](https://github.com/asm198x/asm198x/blob/main/crates/isa/src/z80.rs).

Cycle counts show the base cost; `+p` is an extra cycle when an
indexed access crosses a page boundary, `+t` when a branch is taken.

## SWAPNIB

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|  | `ED 23` | — | 2 | 8 | — |

## Provenance

This specification was authored from the following, in the family's primary reference library:

- *Programming the Z80, 2nd edition* — Rodnay Zaks, 1980 (`by-topic/cpu-z80/`)
- *Z80 Microcomputer Handbook* — Sams, 1985 (`by-topic/cpu-z80/`)

Not from any emulator's decode loop: an emulator is a reading of the hardware, and this is meant to be a reading of the documentation.
